title: Python Node forwards IPv6 without decrementing Hop Limit
description: Security codereview finding in python/src/lichen/node.py: Node._process_received parses a valid IPv6 packet, routes it, recompresses the original ipv6_bytes, and forwards it without decrementing packet.header.hop_limit or dropping Hop Limit 0/1. This violates IPv6 relay semantics and spec/04-network.md 6.3.2, defeats the packet's loop/amplification bound, and allows cyclic routes to recirculate traffic after the bounded relay cache is displaced. Before passive learning/forwarding, reject exhausted Hop Limit and serialize an otherwise identical packet with Hop Limit decremented exactly once; preserve source/payload/checksum semantics and add unicast/multicast boundary regressions for 0, 1, and 2.
